name: Umbra Electric
brandStatement: Umbra Electric is a Seattle-based premium electric mobility retailer established in 2022, curating high-end electric dirt bikes, e-motos and e-bikes for adults and kids. Umbra Electric ships across the United States, Europe and worldwide, specializing in flagship off-road and trail machines from the brands that define the category. What sets Umbra apart is ruthless curation — only bikes worth owning.
